sources.title: Justrinsato/tiny-transformer-contrastive · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview This repository is a compact, custom PyTorch implementation of Tiny Transformer for Contrastive. The base configuration is intended for code review, smoke tests, and small controlled experiments rather than as a production-ready pretrained release.

sources.title: GitHub - mmpmmpmmpjosh/TinyFormer
sources.snippet: TinyFormer is a high-performance real-time object detector that bridges the gap between YOLO-style efficiency and DETR-based precision. By introducing the Parallel Bi-fusion Module (PBM) and Spatial Semantic Adapter (SSA), it effectively preserves fine-grained spatial information, achieving State-of-the-Art performance in tiny object detection without compromising inference speed.
